name: mcp-tools
description: Connect Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to provide tools: one PersonalClaw starts with a command (stdio), or one at a URL over Streamable HTTP or the older SSE transport.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Transport
x-meta.help: How PersonalClaw reaches the server: stdio starts it with a command, http connects to its URL over Streamable HTTP, and sse over the older SSE transport.

x-meta.label: Command
x-meta.help: Command to start the MCP server (stdio transport).

x-meta.label: Arguments
x-meta.help: Space-separated arguments for the command. A value in them that looks like a credential is shown masked: leave the mask to keep that value, or type over it to replace it. Arguments are kept in mcp.json as written; a token in the server's environment, set on the Tools page, is kept in your credential store instead.

x-meta.label: URL
x-meta.help: The server's MCP endpoint for the http or sse transport (e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp). A part of it that can carry a credential is shown masked: leave the URL as it is to keep it, or type it in full, the credential included, to change it.
